t: Application From Mr. A.E. Golubeff For Assistance

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5612
Date 9 / 1 / 34

January 3, 34.

Dr. H. Smith,
Superintendent of Hospitals,
S. M. C.

Bearer, Mr. A.M. Golubeff, an employee of the
Passport Section of the Bureau of Public Safety for
the past several years, has at all times willingly
assisted (unofficially) officers of the Municipal
Police in the matter of the movements of criminal and
political suspects of non-treaty nationality.

In view of his valuable services, anything you
can do to assist towards the accommodation in the
Municipal Sanatarium, Macleod Road, of his wife who is
suffering from tuberculosis, will be much appreciated
by this Department.

(sd) R. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner
(Crime Branch)

Mr. Golubeff informed
verbally by D.S.I. Prokofiev
that this recommendation does
not include liability on the part
of the SMP in case of possible
default in the matter of hospital
charges.
HR

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 5612
日期 34年1月9日

1934年1月3日。

H. Smith 博士，
医院总监，
工部局。

持函人 A.M. Golubeff 先生，系公共安全局护照科雇员，过去数年间一直自愿（非正式地）协助警务处官员处理非条约国国籍的刑事及政治嫌疑人的动向事宜。

鉴于其提供的宝贵服务，若贵方能协助将其患有肺结核的妻子安置于麦克劳德路（Macleod Road）的工部局疗养院，本部门将不胜感激。

（签名）R. M. Bourne.
副总监
（刑事股）

Golubeff 先生已由特别股督察长 Prokofiev 口头告知，本推荐信并不包含在可能发生的医院费用拖欠情况下，由上海公共租界工部局警务处承担任何责任之意。
HR

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / Fire & S. B. REGISTRY. / No. D 5612 / SECTION 2 / Date 9 / 1 / 34）
Date January 9, 1934

Subject (in full) Application from Mr. A.E. Golubeff for assistance.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by O. J. [签名]

Mr. A.E. Golubeff, a clerk in the employ of the
Passport Section of the Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety, applied
to Dr. Smith, Doctor i/c Municipal Sanatorium for tuberculars, for
admittance of his wife suffering from tuberculosis into the Sanato-
rium. According to our information the only obstacle in the way of
granting this application is the fact that Golubeff has been resi-
dent in the Settlement for about a month only, while the regulations
stipulate 6 months residence in the Settlement before this privilege
can be granted. It is understood, however, that Dr. Smith is prepared
to admit Mrs Golubeff into the Sanatorium if he had some document
which could serve as an excuse for making the case an exception
from the regulations in force.

Mr. Golubeff's services to the Municipal Police in the
matter of furnishing information regarding criminal and political
suspects of non-treaty nationality have been most valuable.

D.C. (Comi)
I suggest a recommendation
under your signature. I attach
draft letter to Dr Smith for
consideration
Thos Robertson
Supt.

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 消防与特别股登记处。/ 编号 D 5612 / 第2股 / 日期 34年1月9日）
日期 1934年1月9日

主题（全称） A.E. Golubeff 先生申请援助一事。

由特别股督察长 Prokofiev 呈报。经 O. J. [签名] 转递

A.E. Golubeff 先生，系上海公共安全局护照科职员，向负责结核病工部局疗养院的 Smith 医生提出申请，请求接纳其患有肺结核的妻子入住该疗养院。据我方所知，批准此申请的唯一障碍在于 Golubeff 仅在租界居住约一个月，而规章规定须在此特权授予前在租界居住满六个月。然而据悉，若 Smith 医生能持有某种文件，作为将此案作为现行规章例外处理的理由，他准备接纳 Golubeff 夫人入住疗养院。

Golubeff 先生在提供有关非条约国国籍刑事及政治嫌疑人情报方面，为警务处提供了极具价值的服务。

刑事股副总监
我建议以您的名义出具一封推荐信。随附致 Smith 医生的信函草稿，供审阅
Thos Robertson
警司

A. Prokofiev
特别股督察长

特别股主管警官。
